h: Zimbabwean tycoon Wicknell Chivayo's custom Rolls-Royce Phantom arrives weeks after his death in a helicopter crash
p: A custom Rolls-Royce Phantom ordered by Zimbabwean businessman Wicknell Chivayo has reportedly arrived at his Harare home, weeks after he died in a helicopter crash.
more: The car was ordered before his death.
Photos of its arrival have spread widely online.
